reuse.why: Changes the existing shared getScheduledAmount and keeps using the existing getApproxNumberThreshold helper for the tolerance.

duplication.why: The rule is simplified in its single definition (Math.min / amount - threshold); no logic is copied.

placement.why: The edit lives in shared/schedules.ts, the one function all schedule-amount consumers already call.

scope.why: Only the rule, a variable rename that matches the new meaning, and the matching tests are touched.

maintainability.why: The new rule is shorter and more obvious than the old one, with tests covering income, expense and zero-spanning ranges.
